name: Yumeiro Panny
source:
She's the host at the Totocalcio Venue, an authorized town facility where people can bet on the results of the Toushin Tournament matches.
She has a bright and sociable personality, and is friendly even to newcomers.
When there are no matches, she sometimes works as a seller at food stand.
